---
title: "MGLTools 1.5.7"
---

MGLTools 1.5.7 is the latest version. It provides:

- a redesigned dashboard widget
- a sequence viewer widget
- performance optimizations
- new commands for superimposition and RMSD calculations

[Download MGLTools 1.5.7](../download.qmd#version-1.5.7). Patched Linux builds are also
available on the [Download](../download.qmd) page.

There is no separate documentation for 1.5.7; the most recent documentation is
for [version 1.5.6](../1.5.6/index.qmd).
